echo '=== OWNER LOGIN WITH PROVIDED CREDENTIALS ==='
EMAIL='iperez4242@gmail.com'
PASSWORD='X146corp@1x146corp$$1'
API_BASE='https://api.ivxholding.com'

# Try passwordless login endpoint with emergency mode first
RESP1=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL\",\"emergency\":\"ivx_emergency_recovery\"}" \
  "$API_BASE/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login" 2>&1)

echo "Passwordless login response (safe):"
echo "$RESP1" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k: ('***' if 'token' in k.lower() or 'key' in k.lower() or 'secret' in k.lower() else v) for k,v in d.items()}, indent=2))" 2>/dev/null || echo "$RESP1" | head -c 300

echo ''
echo '=== Try regular owner login endpoint ==='
RESP2=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"email\":\"$EMAIL\",\"password\":\"$PASSWORD\"}" \
  "$API_BASE/api/ivx/owner/login" 2>&1)

echo "Owner login response (safe):"
echo "$RESP2" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k: ('***' if 'token' in k.lower() or 'key' in k.lower() or 'secret' in k.lower() else v) for k,v in d.items()}, indent=2))" 2>/dev/null || echo "$RESP2" | head -c 300

echo ''
echo '=== Save token if present ==='
TOKEN1=$(echo "$RESP1" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('accessToken','') or d.get('token',''))" 2>/dev/null)
TOKEN2=$(echo "$RESP2" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('accessToken','') or d.get('token',''))" 2>/dev/null)
TOKEN=${TOKEN1:-$TOKEN2}
if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "Token obtained (length ${#TOKEN}), saving..."
  echo "$TOKEN" > /tmp/ivx_owner_token.txt
  chmod 600 /tmp/ivx_owner_token.txt
  echo "Token saved to /tmp/ivx_owner_token.txt"
else
  echo "No token obtained from login responses"
fi

echo '=== MINT S3 PRESIGNED URL FOR APK UPLOAD ==='
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/ivx_owner_token.txt 2>/dev/null)
API_BASE='https://api.ivxholding.com'
APK_PATH=/home/user/rork-app/expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then
  echo 'No owner token'
  exit 1
fi

# Get the presigned URL for the APK
PRESIGN_RESP=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"key":"apk/ivx-holdings-v1.9.5.apk","confirm":true,"confirmText":"CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}' \
  "$API_BASE/api/ivx/apk-presign-upload")

echo 'Presign response (safe):'
echo "$PRESIGN_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k: ('***' if k in ('uploadUrl','signature') or 'url' in k.lower() else v) for k,v in d.items()}, indent=2))"

UPLOAD_URL=$(echo "$PRESIGN_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('uploadUrl',''))")
PUBLIC_URL=$(echo "$PRESIGN_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('publicUrl',''))")

if [ -z "$UPLOAD_URL" ]; then
  echo 'Failed to get presigned URL'
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Upload APK to S3 ==="
echo "Upload URL (hidden): ${UPLOAD_URL:0:50}..."
curl -s -m 120 -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive' \
  --upload-file "$APK_PATH" \
  "$UPLOAD_URL" \
  -o /tmp/s3_upload_response.txt \
  -w "\nHTTP %{http_code} | size_upload %{size_upload}\n"

echo ""
echo "=== Upload response ==="
cat /tmp/s3_upload_response.txt

echo ""
echo "=== Verify public URL ==="
if [ -n "$PUBLIC_URL" ]; then
  curl -s -o /dev/null -I -L -w "HEAD: %{http_code} | type %{content_type} | size %{size_download}\n" "$PUBLIC_URL"
  
  echo "Download and verify SHA-256..."
  rm -f /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
  curl -s -L "$PUBLIC_URL" -o /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
  ls -lh /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
  sha256sum /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
  sha256sum "$APK_PATH"
fi

  echo -n 'SHA-256: '; sha256sum "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'

  if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
    echo ''
    echo '=== APK is ready. Minting S3 presign URL and uploading ==='
    PRESIGN_RESP=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"key":"apk/ivx-holdings-v1.9.5.apk","confirm":true,"confirmText":"CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}' \
      "$API_BASE/api/ivx/apk/presign-upload")
    
    UPLOAD_URL=$(echo "$PRESIGN_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('uploadUrl',''))")
    PUBLIC_URL=$(echo "$PRESIGN_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('publicUrl',''))")
    
    if [ -n "$UPLOAD_URL" ]; then
      echo "Uploading to S3..."
      curl -s -m 180 -X PUT \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive' \
        --upload-file "$APK" \
        "$UPLOAD_URL" \
        -o /tmp/s3_upload_response.txt \
        -w "\nHTTP %{http_code} | size_upload %{size_upload}\n"
      
      echo ''
      echo '=== Verify public URL ==='
      curl -s -o /dev/null -I -L -w "HEAD: %{http_code} | type %{content_type} | size %{size_download}\n" "$PUBLIC_URL"
      
      rm -f /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      curl -s -L "$PUBLIC_URL" -o /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      ls -lh /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      echo 'Downloaded SHA-256:'; sha256sum /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      echo 'Original SHA-256:'; sha256sum "$APK"
    else
      echo 'Failed to mint presign URL'
      echo "$PRESIGN_RESP"
    fi
  else
    echo 'No owner token available for S3 upload'
  fi
else
  echo 'APK not ready yet'
fi

    echo ''
    echo '=== APK ready. Uploading to S3 ==='

    if [ -n "$UPLOAD_URL" ]; then
      echo "Uploading to S3..."
      curl -s -m 180 -X PUT \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive' \
        --upload-file "$APK" \
        "$UPLOAD_URL" \

        -w "\nHTTP %{http_code} | size_upload %{size_upload}\n"
      
      touch /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-uploaded.flag
      
      echo ''
      echo '=== Verify public URL ==='
      curl -s -o /dev/null -I -L -w "HEAD: %{http_code} | type %{content_type} | size %{size_download}\n" "$PUBLIC_URL"
      
      rm -f /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      curl -s -L "$PUBLIC_URL" -o /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      ls -lh /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      echo 'Downloaded SHA-256:'; sha256sum /tmp/ivx-apk-s3-downloaded.apk
      echo 'Original SHA-256:'; sha256sum "$APK"
      echo "Public URL: $PUBLIC_URL"
    else
      echo 'Failed to mint presign URL'
      echo "$PRESIGN_RESP"
    fi
  else
    echo 'Token missing or already uploaded'
  fi
else
  echo 'APK not ready yet'
fi
